data.exact_reserve_text: Across all classes combined, we had a net reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m. In 2017 we had a net reserve release of GBP 0.8m. The principal driver of this strengthening related to Professional Liability and Financial Institutions accounts as noted above. As stated previously we are withdrawing from these classes. This deterioration was partially offset by releases from our Property account where net losses settled within our original estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 321.768m. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded a net prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m (net of reinsurance), driven principally by adverse developments in Professional Liability and Financial Institutions, and by large catastrophe activity during the year; this was partially offset by favourable development in Property where net losses settled within original estimates. The net movement represents a modest deterioration of c.2.1% of opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: This deterioration was partially offset by releases from our Property account where net losses settled within our original estimates.

produced a significant loss, with additional information leading to increases in a number of large claims together with further attritional deterioration resulting in a significant strengthening of our prior year reserves
Overall on an aggregate basis, a reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2018. In 2017 there was a reserve release of GBP 0.8m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (prior year column 2017) = GBP 321,768k. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided; only a net reserve strengthening of GBP 6.7m (net of reinsurance) is stated in the Managing Agent's Report and has been used as the prior_year_development_gbp_m (gross unavailable) and flagged accordingly. Line-of-business reserve amounts are not quantified in the report; LOB directions inferred from narrative. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 36) and could be used to compute gross PYD as an alternative, but the report's narrative only quantifies net movement.
